title: Tesla invoice archive
subtitle: Archive original receipts from Tesla app exports and match them to charging sessions.

upload.title: Upload Tesla invoices
upload.hint: Upload individual Tesla PDFs or a ZIP export directly here. Odovi stores them safely in the import folder and processes them automatically.
upload.drop: Drop PDF or ZIP files here
upload.supported: PDF or ZIP · max 25 MB per file · up to 20 files
upload.queued: They will be processed automatically during the next worker cycle.
upload.invalid: At least one file is not a supported PDF or ZIP.
upload.tooLarge: At least one file exceeds the 25 MB file limit.
upload.failed: The upload could not be completed.

import.title: Alternative: automatic import folder
import.hint: PDF or ZIP files can still be copied directly into the mounted import folder. The Odovi worker picks them up during the next sync cycle.

empty.title: No Tesla invoices for this month yet
empty.hint: Export invoices in the Tesla app and upload the PDF or ZIP directly to Odovi above.

delete.confirmOne: Really delete this invoice? The original PDF and its charging-session link will be removed. This cannot be undone.
delete.confirmMany: Really delete {count} invoices? Their original PDFs and charging-session links will be removed. This cannot be undone.
delete.failed: The invoice(s) could not be fully deleted.
delete.costWarning: At least one automatically imported charging cost could not be reset; please review the affected charging session.
